prompt_text: What is the best tanning salon in Tyler TX?
answer_verbatim:
Do you mean UV tanning (beds) or a spray tan? I don’t have live web access to pull up current ratings, but I can quickly help you find the best option and make the right choice. Which would you prefer?

If you want immediate guidance, here are easy steps and what to look for when choosing a tanning salon in Tyler:

How to find top salons
- Search Google Maps, Yelp, or Facebook for “tanning salon near Tyler, TX” and sort/filter by rating (4.0+).  
- Check the most recent reviews (last 6–12 months) and look for comments about cleanliness, staff professionalism, and consistency.  
- Look at photos (facilities and machines) and the salon’s website or Instagram for examples of spray tans, if relevant.

What to check before you go
- Type of service: spray tan vs. high-pressure or low-pressure UV beds; ask which they recommend for your skin type.  
- Cleanliness: are beds/booths and common areas well maintained? Do reviewers mention sanitation?  
- Equipment/solutions: reputable spray solutions (vegan/cruelty-free options if desired); modern, well-maintained beds for UV tanning.  
- Staff training: certified technicians or licensed spray-tan artists.  
- Pricing & packages: single sessions, packages, membership deals, and cancellation policies.  
- Safety practices: patch test for spray tans, up-to-date bulb replacement and eye/skin protection for UV, and clear guidance on exposure limits.  
- Hours & location: convenient schedule and nearby parking.

Red flags
- Multiple recent complaints about hygiene.  
- No clear safety protocols for UV exposure or no patch tests for spray.  
- Staff unwilling to answer questions about products or equipment.  
- Very low prices compared with area averages (might indicate poor quality/safety).

If you want, tell me:
- Whether you want spray or UV, and
- Your ZIP or part of Tyler (east/west/near UT Tyler, etc.),

and I’ll draft a short phone/script you can use to check the top salons, or give a checklist to compare a few candidates you find.
